definitions.explanation: A friend or close acquaintance. More literary or formal than {友達|ともだち}. Often used in compound words or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {友|とも}⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{遠方|えんぽう}→遠方：19464_enpou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{来|き}たる→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.notes: Famous quote from the Analects of Confucius

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦楽|くらく}→苦楽：05566_kuraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共|とも}に→共に：03468_tomoni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{友|とも}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He is a friend who has shared both hardships and joys with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧{友|とも}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: An old friend is a good friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友|とも}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{真|しん}→真：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友|とも}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友|とも}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶりに→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met up with a friend from my school days after a long time.

notes:
USAGE: {友|とも} is more literary and formal than ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧. It appears frequently in compounds, proverbs, and classical expressions.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧ (friend - formal)
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧ (friendship)
- ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧ (close friend)
- ⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧ (old friend)
- ⟦{学友|がくゆう}→学友：27117_gakuyuu⟧ (school friend)
- ⟦{戦友|せんゆう}→戦友：20019_senyuu⟧ (comrade in arms)
- ⟦{友好|ゆうこう}→友好：03644_yuukou⟧ (friendship, amity)

CLASSICAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {友|とも}⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{遠方|えんぽう}→遠方：19464_enpou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{来|き}たる→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (A friend comes from afar - Confucius)
- ⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧{友|とも} (a good friend)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {友|とも} - literary/formal
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧ - everyday word for friend
